notes.text: The father’s title is abbreviated ר׳ in the supplied second notice. The William Davidson digital text of Nazir 23a fully writes Rabbi Yose bar Rav Choni (רבי יוסי בר רב חוני), supporting Rav for the father’s title. The Mishnah notice remains separate.

The whole Davidson Nazir 23a paragraph explicitly writes Rabbi Yose bar Rav Choni, locally supporting those titles. The separate untitled Mishnah pointer and source bar form remain distinct from any uncollated ben form. The current note remains verbatim; no father or identity merge is made.
